home.faqDescription: Can't see yours? Our experts reply within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Is it free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes. Searching, comparing and getting help from our housing experts is free for students. Properties pay us when a booking is made.

faqs.question: When should I book?
faqs.answer: Popular rooms near big universities often sell out 4–6 months before term starts, so we recommend enquiring as soon as you have an offer.

faqs.question: What if my visa is refused?
faqs.answer: Properties marked “No Visa, No Pay” refund your booking if your visa is refused. Each property page lists its cancellation policy.

faqs.question: Are bills included?
faqs.answer: Many properties include Wi-Fi, electricity, water and heating. Look for “Bills included” on listings, or use the filter.

faqs.question: Do I need a guarantor?
faqs.answer: Some properties require one. If you don't have a guarantor, many accept upfront payment or an international guarantor service — we can advise.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: {site} is a prototype. This notice explains what we collect and why, in line with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) and similar laws where you live.
privacy.collect: Your name, email and, if you give them, phone number, nationality, study plans and budget. We also record the steps you take on the site — searches, cities and homes you view, rooms you pick and enquiries you send — so our experts can help you faster.
privacy.use: To reply to your enquiries, recommend rooms, and improve the site. If you agree, we share your contact details and study plans with accommodation providers so they can contact you. We never sell your data.
privacy.rights: You can see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, at any time from your profile or by emailing {email}.
